messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the one-piece garment and footwear shown in the reference images. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete target outfit, and the second shows its back view. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects of the person and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's whole outfit with the one-piece garment and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands in profile, raises one hand to her hair, then turns to face away from the camera while keeping a hand on her hip.","camera":"Static wide shot at a low angle, keeping the character centered in an open plaza.","clothing":"A short blue-and-white patterned dress with short sleeves and red sneakers with white soles.","hair_color":"White or platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, straight hair with a side part and a small ponytail or tie at the back.","identity":"A slender 3D-rendered female character with dark skin, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"A sunny outdoor fairground or amusement park with a striped carousel on the left, wooden stalls and a red-roofed structure on the right, and a pale sky overhead."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's crop top, light trousers, and dark boots were replaced with a short blue-and-white patterned one-piece dress and red sneakers with white soles. The scene, camera, pose sequence, and white hair remained largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the blue-and-white one-piece garment and red footwear shown in the references, leaving non-clothing aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Exact match of the dress pattern and shoe details to the reference images is difficult to verify from the video frames.
unexpected_changes: The character's skin tone appears darker in the output than in the source, although this was not requested.
